mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply-side constraints, which can lead to reduced output and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO declines by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals disinflationary pressures, which can lead to increased real income and consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL declines by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising real GDP (GDPC1) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases in the same quarter.
